variants.promptText: Immersive first-person flying camera perspective, no visible drone or flying device. The camera dives through an ancient jungle temple swallowed by storm clouds, racing between vines, stone statues, waterfalls, and glowing ruins. At the end, the temple opens into a massive underground sun, releasing golden shockwaves and levitating stone rings. Continuous POV shot, no cuts, aggressive banking, cinematic motion blur, volumetric mist, high-end fantasy VFX.

purpose: Study a continuous FPV fantasy-environment sequence with aggressive banking, volumetric mist and a strong final reveal.
